verdict.headline: This NDA is completely one-sided, imposes perpetual liability, and strips standard confidentiality protections.
summary: The agreement defines confidential information to include public facts and your own prior knowledge, with zero standard carve-outs.
Your confidentiality obligations last forever and include a one-sided full indemnity, while the discloser is free to share your recipes and pricing.
Only the discloser can terminate the agreement, and it bars you from consulting your own lawyers or accountants without prior permission.

findings.quote: "Confidential Information" means all information of any kind whatsoever, in any form or medium, whether or not marked as confidential, that is disclosed to or obtained by the Recipient or its Representatives in connection with the Purpose or the Proposed Arrangement, including recipes, product specifications, supplier lists, pricing, volumes, sales data, outlet information, business plans, and any information that the Recipient already holds or that is in the public domain, together with all notes, analyses and other materials prepared by the Recipient that contain or reflect any such information.

findings.standard: Standard NDAs strictly exclude information that is publicly known, already known prior to receipt, independently developed, or obtained from a legitimate third party.
findings.suggested_ask: Please exclude public domain information, third-party disclosures, and pre-existing knowledge from the definition of Confidential Information.

summary: The agreement slips in an aggressive non-compete that could shut down Lumio Tani's own core agritech business across ASEAN for three years.

This contract is governed by the laws of the State of New York, United States of America; we check it against Malaysian law only as a fallback.

findings.why_risky: An NDA should only protect shared confidential information, but this clause prohibits you from running or developing your own smart irrigation and farm monitoring business across all ASEAN countries for six years in total, directly endangering your company's existence.
findings.standard: Standard NDAs never include a non-compete clause, and disclaimers usually confirm both parties remain free to independently develop competing products.
findings.suggested_ask: Please delete the non-compete wording; this NDA should only protect confidential information, and either party should stay free to do business as long as it does not misuse that information.

verdict.headline: Dangerous one-way NDA that disclaims all confidentiality duties, frees the investor to share secrets, and makes you indemnify them.
summary: The agreement states that the investor has no obligation to keep your business secrets confidential or restrict their use.
The investor completely disclaims all liability for leaks, while making you warrant the accuracy of all information and indemnify them.
Broad residuals and competitor-support clauses allow the investor to freely use your know-how to back competing food businesses.

findings.title: Investor expressly disclaims any duty of confidentiality
findings.quote: The Investor is not obliged to keep Confidential Information confidential, to restrict its use to the Purpose, or to apply any particular standard of care to it.
findings.why_risky: This clause completely defeats the entire purpose of a confidentiality agreement. The investor can freely leak, share, or use your recipes, formulations, supplier terms, and financials without restriction.
findings.standard: An NDA must strictly obligate the recipient to keep information confidential, use it solely for evaluating the potential transaction, and apply at least a reasonable standard of care.
findings.suggested_ask: Please delete this sentence and replace it with standard mutual obligations to keep information confidential and use it solely for the Purpose.

findings.standard: The receiving party should ensure that any representative who receives information is bound by confidentiality duties and remains liable for their breaches.

summary: The contract denies interest rebates on early settlement and attempts to repossess without statutory notice after a single default.
It ties vehicle insurance exclusively to the dealer's insurer and completely disclaims vehicle condition and dealer promises.
Disputes are restricted to owner-selected arbitration while forcing a severe 3-month limitation period on your claims.

findings.standard: Late fees should be modest simple interest charged solely on the overdue amount without compounding.

verdict.headline: High risk due to full deposit forfeiture on early exit, unequal termination notice, and automatic two-year renewal.
summary: The agreement forfeits your entire RM1,500 deposit if you leave early, regardless of the landlord's actual loss.
The landlord can evict you with only 7 days' notice without cause, while you must give 2 months' notice.
The tenancy automatically renews for 2-year blocks unless you give written notice 60 days in advance.

findings.suggested_ask: Please let the tenant leave early on 2 months' written notice with deductions limited to actual losses until re-let, rather than full deposit forfeiture.

findings.title: Severely unbalanced termination notice periods
findings.quote: Pemilik boleh menamatkan Perjanjian ini pada bila-bila masa atas apa-apa sebab dengan memberi notis bertulis tujuh (7) hari kepada Penyewa, dan Penyewa hendaklah mengosongkan Bilik pada akhir tempoh notis itu.
findings.why_risky: The landlord can terminate for any reason on merely 7 days' notice, while clause 6.2 binds you to give 2 months' notice. Seven days is insufficient time to find alternative housing.
